name: io.github.apyrobo/apyrobo
title: APYROBO
description: Safety layer between AI agents and robots: clamps speeds, refuses moves into no-go zones

packageArguments.name: --robot
packageArguments.description: Robot URI, e.g. mock://turtlebot4 (no robot needed) or ros2://turtlebot3

packageArguments.name: --policy-file
packageArguments.description: JSON or YAML safety policy (max_speed, max_angular_speed, no_go_zones); command-line flags override it

packageArguments.name: --max-speed
packageArguments.description: Speed limit in m/s; faster moves are clamped

packageArguments.name: --no-go
packageArguments.description: Rectangular no-go zone in metres as X_MIN,Y_MIN,X_MAX,Y_MAX; moves into it are refused
